message.content:
Self-adhesive printed paper labels fall under heading 4911 or 4821. Heading 4821 covers paper or paperboard labels of all kinds, whether or not printed. However, printed labels where the printing is not merely incidental to the primary use are classified in 4911. Here the labels carry logos and are used as seals, so the printing is arguably incidental to the use. For comparison, CBP rulings on printed self-adhesive labels carrying a logo usually place them in 4911.99 when the printing is not incidental. Heading 4821 covers "printed" labels, and the Harmonized System explanatory notes say 4821 includes printed labels such as those bearing brand names. So 4821 is the likely heading.

Within 4821, subheading 4821.10 covers printed labels and 4821.90 covers other. Under 4821.10, the 10-digit statistical suffix is 4821.10.2000 for those not printed with a design... The HTSUS breakdown is:
- 4821.10.20 – Printed: Rolled labels? 

I recall 4821.10.20 as "Printed: Pressure-sensitive" and 4821.10.40 as "Other", with statistical suffixes under .20 being 00 (4821.10.2000). That seems right.
